# 0.8.0-alpha01

> **Alpha, not tested on a phone yet.** Unit tests and emulator flows pass; nothing new here has been checked on a real device. Expect bugs and report them on GitHub.
>
> Version `0.8.0-alpha01` (`1800001`). Installs as **Editotsu α** (`ani.editotsu.beta`) and updates 0.7 in place.

- **New Features:**
  - AnimeThemes, take two
    - Themes tab on every anime page: openings, endings, every version, and a spoiler shield so episode 24's ending stays a surprise
    - Heart a theme to keep it. Play your favourites, shuffle them, or start theme radio and let it keep going
    - Download themes as audio or video and play them offline. Airplane-mode karaoke is now supported
    - Audio only toggle in the theme lists, for when you want the song and not the screen
    - During an episode's OP/ED a now-playing chip names the song. Heart it before the credits roll
  - Settings, rebuilt from scratch
    - Every screen is drawn from one list, so they finally look like they belong to the same app
    - One "Show advanced settings" per screen; the scary options live there
    - Search jumps straight to the setting and flashes it
    - Audio delay, subtitle delay, subtitle speed and volume boost are separate rows that show their values
    - Live subtitle preview while you pick colour, font and size
  - Torrents, part one
    - Torrents you watched before start in under a second (was about four)
    - The rest is cooking for the next alphas: preparing a release while you're still choosing, reading only what the player needs, faster seeks, and a TorrServer add-on. Stay tuned
  - Source picker filters behind one icon: match count at the top, counts on every chip ("1080p · 22"), long release-group lists folded to the top six
  - Player screenshots land in your gallery with names you can read (show, episode, time)
  - The player now hides a list of its hidden gestures. Finding it is left as an exercise
  - Every player button has a name for TalkBack
  - MAL and AniList account cards finally match

- **Bugfixes:**
  - Restoring a backup wiped every reading setting. Fixed, and backups made with 0.7 restore fine too
  - Subscriptions announcing an episode that aired days ago
  - Subscriptions announcing episodes AniList hasn't aired yet because someone mislabelled a torrent
  - "Episode 6: Episode 6: Title" in notifications. Once was enough
  - Crash after leaving the theme player
  - Settings search closing the app on the first letter (0.8 test builds only)
  - Small UI and padding fixes

- **Known issues:**
  - A torrent you haven't played before can still take 5 to 30 seconds to start on a slow swarm, and long seeks are slow. See "Torrents, part one"
  - The picker filter sheet wears the default sheet colour instead of the picker's
  - AnimeThemes can take up to a minute the first time you open a show
  - The Degoogle'd build has no in-app updater

- **Which apk?**
  - `Editotsu-0.8.0-alpha01-google-arm64-v8a.apk`: most modern phones
  - `Editotsu-0.8.0-alpha01-google-universal.apk`: other architectures
  - `Editotsu-0.8.0-alpha01-fdroid-arm64-v8a.apk`: Degoogle'd, most modern phones
  - `Editotsu-0.8.0-alpha01-fdroid-universal.apk`: Degoogle'd, other architectures
